{{Top|leg}}
The '''Signal Corps''' was a branch of the [[Alanciari military]]. Prior to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] of [[Alanciar]] in [[2975 BBY]], it was an independent continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that was not ruled by the Sith. The [[Alanciari]] who made up the Signal Corps worked in [[signal station]]s, tower-like structures within which they operated [[fireglobe]]s to send coded messages to other signal stations via a [[Language/Legends|language]] known as [[semaphore]]. One known member of the Signal Corps was [[Jogan Halder]], who would help the Sith reunify Alanciar by convincing the Alanciari that the Sith did not pose a threat to them.
